title.narrative: Labour market outcomes for migrant workers are improved, and their protection strengthened

description.narrative: Migrant workers in Sri Lanka continue to face risks of exploitation, inadequate protection, and limited access to social support, compounded by regulatory gaps and the absence of effective emergency evacuation mechanisms. These efforts directly benefit migrant workers while contributing to a more equitable and well-regulated labour market through improved protections and fair labour standards.
